title: Run comm-eff signed_ema vs dense on DeepScaleR RLVR, R1-Distill-1.5B, AIME val (RLVR-Linearity repro surface)
orchestrator_launch: launch.sh ran dense-control (to step 102, no ckpt); launch2.sh runs the 3 comm-eff arms at 102 steps / save_freq 100 (operator re-plan 2026-07-09).
plan_revision_note: REVISED 2026-07-08 (operator, in-flight): re-pointed to the RLVR-Linearity reproduction (2048/16384/n=16, AIME-only val math-ai/aime24 avg@8, offload OFF on 4xH200). RE-REVISED 2026-07-09 (operator, live): all arms capped at 102 steps (was 200), checkpoint at step 100 (SAVE_FREQ 200->100). dense-control was already ~step 94 with save_freq=200 baked in, so it finishes to 102 WITHOUT a checkpoint (operator choice; curve+val kept on WandB + train_dense-control.log); the 3 comm-eff arms run via launch2.sh with a global_step_100 checkpoint mirrored to R2. Comparison point for all arms = step ~100/102 (AIME avg@8 val fires at step 100; train reward curve to 102).

cells.name: dense-control
cells.role: RLVR-Linearity reproduction + reward-health gate + dense reference (comm-eff OFF)

cells.name: signed-ema-b50-la
cells.role: b50 + fixed_linear lookahead strength=1.0 — hypothesis candidate

shared_overrides.note: OFFLOAD ASYMMETRY (operator fix 2026-07-09): dense-control ran offload OFF and fit; the 3 comm-eff arms run param_offload=True + optimizer_offload=True (trailing Hydra override in launch2.sh) because they OOM'd at the first anchor refresh (replay_paired_batch extra fwd+bwd) with offload OFF at the 143GB ceiling. Offload = storage location only (CPU 1.5TB RAM), NO numeric change, so the comm-eff-vs-dense comparison stays valid. Asymmetric clip 0.2/0.28 + seq-mean-token-mean = reference fidelity, intentional deviation from the vanilla-GRPO control (flagged in the plan).

wandb.project_rule: per-issue project = run_id (operator directive 2026-07-08); never the global verl_compression_research

data.prep: on-box in launch.sh: prepare_rlvr_math.py --dataset deepscaler (--train-cap 20000 --val-size 500); prepare_aime_boxed.py (30 unique problems, data_source=math-ai/aime24, routes to math_reward via router entry @ eeafc2a5)
data.preamble_note: cell 1 has a one-time data-prep + R1-Distill model download preamble (several min) before the first global_step; cells 2-4 reuse cached data/model.

metrics.note: val = AIME-2024 ONLY (30 problems, avg@8, every 25 steps). Cross-arm parity corroborated by the deepscaler TRAIN reward curve (low-variance signal); AIME avg@8 is the capability headline.

success_criteria: all attempted cells reach step 102 with no NaN / non-finite grad_norm (operator re-plan 2026-07-09: 102 steps, was 200)
reward-health gate: dense-control step-100 val-core/math-ai/aime24/acc/mean@8 >= 0.10 (else STOP = documented negative). dense step-0..100 already >= 0.19 -> gate cleared.
headline: max over {signed-ema-b50, signed-ema-b50-la} of step-100 AIME avg@8 >= (dense step-100 - 0.05), corroborated by the training reward curve; all arms compared at step 100 (val fires at 100)

each comm-eff arm's step-100 checkpoint (hf_model+optimizer) mirrored to R2 verl-research/63-deepscaler-r1d-signed-ema-k20/<cell>/checkpoints/global_step_100/ (dense-control has no checkpoint by operator choice)
report (non-gating): signed-ema-b00 + all arms' AIME val-core/math-ai/aime24 (avg@8)

checkpoints.policy: operator re-plan 2026-07-09: comm-eff arms save global_step_100 (SAVE_FREQ=100, TOTAL=102). dense-control saves NOTHING (was save_freq=200, killed at 102 by operator choice).
checkpoints.verify: per finished comm-eff cell check [ckpt_r2] queued / close() OK lines in the cell log; failed upload leaves local files (delete is post-verify) -> hand-mirror with aws s3 cp before the next cell

compute.mode: attach (operator hand-off, ledger status=EXTERNAL, reaper hands-off; teardown at /close via vast-teardown)
compute.pacing: ~484 s/step measured at this surface on 4xH200 -> ~27 h/arm for 200 steps
compute.note: operator-provided 4xH200 44208646 (team), migrated from 1xH200 44198237 (torn down). Attached box: NEVER auto-provision a replacement on env-failure. OPERATOR_STOP sentinel honored.
